title: RecipientIdentifier re-exported from cms crate leaks pre-release dep into public API
description: key.rs re-exports cms::enveloped_data::RecipientIdentifier directly as a public type in smime-tree's API. cms is pinned at =0.3.0-pre.2 (a pre-release). Callers who implement DecryptionKey must depend on the same exact cms version to use RecipientIdentifier in their match arms. Any cms RC bump breaks all downstream DecryptionKey implementors even if smime-tree itself compiles. This is the classic 'semver-incompatible public dep' problem. The type should be wrapped in a local enum or the exact cms version requirement must be prominently documented.
